name: music-studio
description: Two-mode MCP music studio: scored composition (ABC notation) and live performance (Strudel live coding).
author: Xule Lin

interface.shortDescription: Compose scored music (ABC) and live-code patterns (Strudel) — sheet music, MIDI/WAV export, harmony tools
interface.longDescription: Two-mode MCP music studio: scored composition in ABC notation and live performance via Strudel live coding. Sheet music rendering, in-place editing, MIDI/WAV export, all 128 General MIDI instruments, style presets, harmony analysis, and a live REPL with Hydra shader visuals. The plugin runs the published npm package over stdio (npx mcp-music-studio --stdio). Note: the interactive ext-apps widgets require an MCP client with UI rendering support; in Kimi Code the composition, performance, and analysis tools work, but the widgets do not display.
